name: Kolkata
tagline: Where the past is always present.
description: Kolkata is a city of layered contradictions — colonial grandeur and revolutionary fire, intellectual tradition and chaotic warmth. It invented modern India and now quietly watches what became of it.

culture.title: The intellectual city
culture.body: Kolkata produced Tagore, Ray, and Sen. It hosts the largest book fair in Asia. It has a coffee house where the same conversations have been happening since 1942. It is a city that takes ideas seriously.

craft.title: The terracotta villages
craft.body: The patachitra tradition — storytelling through painted scrolls — survives in the hands of the Chitrakar community in the villages surrounding Kolkata.

people.title: The adda culture
people.body: Adda is the Kolkata practice of purposeless conversation — loitering with words. It is not idle gossip. It is a civilisational practice that produced some of the finest minds in Indian history.

memory.title: Empire's echo
memory.body: Every colonial building in Kolkata tells two stories simultaneously — the story of who built it, and the story of who was displaced to build it. The city holds both without resolving them.
